message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: Defendant Xu sold a house that he had already sold to someone else, concealed the fact, and signed a transfer agreement with victim Wei, got 480,000 RMB, used to repay personal debt. Later returned 50,000. Victim expressed forgiveness.

This is a fraud involving real estate transaction. The charge likely "诈骗" (fraud). Also possibly "合同诈骗" (contract fraud) because he signed a contract to sell property he didn't own. In many examples, similar scenario is labeled "合同诈骗". Let's see training examples: There is example: "合同诈骗" used for cases where fraudulent contract for sale of property. Example: "张1某...签订发包合同...诈骗" labeled "合同诈骗". Also "诈骗" used for general fraud. The list includes both "诈骗" and "合同诈骗". Which is more appropriate? The facts: He signed a house transfer agreement, misrepresented ownership, obtained money. That's contract fraud. So label "合同诈骗". Also maybe "侵占"? No, because he didn't have property to begin with; he misrepresented. So "合同诈骗". Also maybe "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益"? He returned part, but not necessarily. The main charge is contract fraud.

Thus answer: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>
